name: Error Humanizer
description: Rewrites raw agent error messages into short, human-readable replies (with the actual cause kept) using Gemini Flash before they reach the channel.

apiKey.description: Google AI Studio API key. Falls back to models.providers.google.apiKey from openclaw.json, then GEMINI_API_KEY.

timeoutMs.description: Budget for the rewrite call; on timeout the original text is delivered.
